requirements.requirement: The ledger reads as one physical, authored object rather than nested application panels.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Journey/Company captures with textures and shadows both on and off; Robin's visual review.

requirements.requirement: Shape and depth never compromise the reading plane.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Normal/large text and flat mode; no skewed ruby or clipped body text.

requirements.requirement: Page families are distinct without arbitrary navigation.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Six sections plus Inn Ledger and dialogue shown together with a control map.

requirements.requirement: Every existing and approved action remains reachable.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Old-to-new control inventory and focused mouse, keyboard and touch checks.

requirements.requirement: Follow, selection, focus, availability and danger are distinguishable without color alone.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: State captures, keyboard traversal and high-contrast checks.

requirements.requirement: Journey preserves destination, route explanation and hint progression.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Current/unreachable/completed fixtures; hint reveal counts and no accidental repeats.

requirements.requirement: Company preserves the chosen companion, given pet name, Bond text, thoughts and speech settings.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: All four companion fixtures; pet absent/present; pending-story and unavailable-topic states.

requirements.requirement: Distractions remains its own section and obeys venue/companion launch rules.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Safe start/return and story-priority fixtures; no remote physical game introduced.

requirements.requirement: The Inn Ledger stays a six-save interface with honest storage/edition states.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Zero/one/six saves; incompatible save; copy/overwrite/delete and storage-refusal tests.

requirements.requirement: Japanese, furigana and mixed-script text stay correct and legible.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Actual-font audit and glyph specimens; long strings; no missing glyph or ruby overlap.

requirements.requirement: Typography meets the approved readability, tone and offline requirements.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: New-font permission recorded; exact family/licence, readable specimens, glyph/ruby coverage, fallback and offline report.

requirements.requirement: Page motion cannot alter results or lose navigation input.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Transition interruption, repeated inputs, resize and reduced-motion changes; event-count assertions.

requirements.requirement: Dialogue remains manually advanced and available without a pointer.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Click/tap/key Next; history/help open and return; long lines and speaker identity.

requirements.requirement: Writing and typing remain independent of decorative book geometry.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Handwriting hit coordinates; IME composition; keyboard occlusion; confirm/cancel at large text.

requirements.requirement: Compact layout is a real reflow, not a shrunken desktop screenshot.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: 320×640 and 375×667 CSS-pixel fixtures plus short landscape and foldable checks.

requirements.requirement: Battle identity and learning controls remain intact.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Decision/action/entry states; two-person HP/Harmony; temporary banner; Suzu cut-in; crowded layout.

requirements.requirement: Old and new screens share the finished treatment.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Complete screen/state census, including empty/error/long-content/settings/help states.

requirements.requirement: The finished book remains quick and usable.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: Cold/warm menu-open, frame/stall/cache measures on actual tested devices, compared with baseline.

requirements.requirement: Presentation cannot fabricate progress or expose hidden story content.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: State hashes around browsing/replay; spoiler veils; no false stamp/Bond/record award.

requirements.requirement: The pass is visually accepted, not merely declared complete by its author.
requirements.acceptance_evidence: A concise review set and explicit accepted/revise disposition for the remaining artistic issues.
